author: Trunali Chavan
why: Source identifies a giraffe photographed in Kenya. Golden grass and blue sky offer strong poster colour; tall grass may obscure the hooves. Sex unconfirmed.

author: Jonah Brown
why: Caption confirms a giraffe in Amboseli, Kenya. Walking composition with green savanna and an acacia provides habitat context; sex unconfirmed.

author: Giovanni Nicolini
why: Solitary giraffe in open savanna at Tsavo East National Park, Kenya. Uncluttered habitat candidate for a poster; sex and native dimensions unverified.

author: Charmain Jansen van Rensburg
why: Source identifies a giraffe on savannah and lists 3456×5184 pixels with camera EXIF. Portrait orientation is promising for the card; country and sex are unconfirmed.

author: Nad Hemnani
why: Photographer titles this giraffe 'Old Boy'; photographed at Oserengoni Wildlife Sanctuary, Kenya. Promising adult-male candidate; native dimensions and exact framing unverified.

author: Michelangelo Azzariti
why: Caption confirms a giraffe in Tsavo East National Park, Kenya. Tree-side composition offers recognizable safari habitat; sex unconfirmed.

author: Ellen White
why: Source identifies a giraffe at Lewa Wildlife Conservancy, Kenya. Daylight walking view on brown grassland; sex unconfirmed.

author: Eddy Odingo Odira
why: 6000 × 4000 safari photograph from Nairobi National Park, Kenya. Single giraffe in savanna habitat; sex and hooves-to-ossicones crop need visual confirmation.

author: Cody McLain
why: Standing giraffe on open grassland; photographer identifies Nairobi National Park, Kenya. Sex unconfirmed. Across this shortlist, exact hoof-to-ossicone framing, native resolution and direct downloads remain unverified.
